title.narrative: Improving Pacific Islands Customs and Trade (IMPACT - UNCTAD) PRISE - Output 1.1

description.narrative: The overall objective of IMPACT is to boost and increase intra-regional and international trade.IMPACTs specific objective (purpose) is to improve trade facilitation and border/customs procedures. To achieve the objectives, IMPACT will deliver the following Results (Outcomes):Result 1:Improved PACP country ability to benefit from WTO priority measures;Result 2:Harmonised Customs operations across all Pacific ACP;Result 3.National Single Window systems requirements defined and guidelines prepared;Result 4.Strengthened technical understanding, leadership and statistical capacity;

title.narrative: Number of national Single Window blueprints

description.narrative: The implementation of a single window system in PACP states, starting with EPAacceding countries, will enable international (crossborder) traders doing business with the region to submit regulatory documents at a single location and/or single entity. The project will work closely with Fiji, Papua New Guinea, Samoa, Solomon Islands, and Tonga to create pathways (blueprints) for SW establishment as a precursor to rollout across the region, as well as support ongoing efforts in Vanuatu

comment.narrative: The IMPACT Project records and Annual Reports will record the number of SW blueprint reports that have been completed
